model.name: race (generic open-wheel race car, no real-world brand)
model.author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
model.conversion_note: Used as shipped: race.glb references Textures/colormap.png by a relative URI, so both files are kept at the same relative paths.

geometry.forward_axis_gltf: +Z (front wheels at z = +0.64, rear at z = -0.88)
geometry.ground_offset_note: Model origin is at tyre contact: bounding-box minimum y = 0 (wheel centres y = 0.3, radius 0.3) in model units.
geometry.heading_offset_note: Cesium model heading 0 points the model's forward axis east and grows clockwise; route headings are clockwise from north, so model heading = route heading - 90 deg. Checked visually (see docs/evidence/issue-9).

animation.position: linear interpolation on the course polyline (road centre line); geometry is not smoothed
animation.terrain_sample_step_note: Measured on the Sapporo demo course (3,369 m): 2 m = 1,685 samples, ~0.6 s cold with 9 terrain tile requests; 5 m interpolation deviated up to 0.42 m from 2 m samples, above the provisional 0.3 m. Cost is dominated by tile requests, not sample count (docs/evidence/issue-9).
animation.speed_note: Display speed for visualising the route only; not a vehicle dynamics model and not a racing speed.

chase.note: Issue #26: widened from 18 m / -18 deg / default 60 deg FOV so cross streets and intersections stay in view. fov_deg applies to the chase camera only; other modes restore the viewer default. At two sharp corners of the Sapporo demo (s ~1298 m, ~2376 m) the camera passes through a building edge for a few metres (docs/evidence/issue-26).

onboard_like.note: In front of the nose, not a modelled cockpit
